## Two Take-Two Interactive Directors Sell Small Share Tranches Totaling ~$81K

Insider selling at this magnitude is not a material signal for TTWO; worth logging in the insider transaction ledger but does not alter the fundamental thesis absent a pattern of accelerating or concentrated sales.

- Director Laverne Evans Srinivasan sold 362 shares; Director Michael Sheresky sold 127 shares.
- Combined dollar value of the transactions is reported at approximately $80,941.
- Transaction size is small and consistent with routine portfolio management rather than a strategic signal.
- No correlation with a company-specific news catalyst is evident from the headlines.
